response.text:
I can do that, but I won’t cancel anything until you confirm details. Here’s exactly what I would do and what I need from you before proceeding.

What I would do (pick one when you confirm)
- Option A — Cancel the entire recurring series: remove every “Design review” meeting (all past and future occurrences) and send a cancellation to all attendees. Result visible to all invitees. Reversibility: not easily reversible — I could recreate the series but attendee RSVPs and message history would not be restored.
- Option B — Cancel all future occurrences from a specific date onward (keep past occurrences): same attendee visibility and same reversibility limits as above.
- Option C — Cancel a single occurrence (give exact date): only that date is removed; attendees will receive a cancellation for that occurrence. Reversible only by recreating that occurrence.
- Option D — Remove it only from your calendar (decline or delete locally) so other attendees keep the meeting and you are no longer on the invite; organizer/attendees may see your decline. This does not send a cancellation to everyone.

Information I need (confirm these before I act)
1. Exact event name (is it exactly “Design review”?).  
2. Which calendar to change (e.g., Work calendar, Personal).  
3. Exact time and time zone of the meeting (e.g., Tuesdays 3:00–4:00 PM, America/Los_Angeles).  
4. Scope you want (choose A, B, C with start date, or D).  
5. If cancelling for all (A or B or C), do you want me to send cancellation notices to all attendees? (Yes/No)  
6. Any date for Option B or C (if applicable).

Please reply with the event name, calendar, time/time zone, which option (A–D), and whether to notify attendees. Example reply: “Yes — Option A. Event = ‘Design review’, Work calendar, Tuesdays 3–4 PM PT. Send cancellations to all attendees.” Once you confirm exactly, I’ll proceed.
